verdict.rationale: Netlify offers AI agent integrations (docs-21, docs-22) to prompt AI agents to fix/update/ship code using project context, and an AI Gateway to connect to AI models (docs-7), but there's no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's own data (e.g., analytics, usage patterns) as a built-in feature—these are developer-agent workflows rather than data-insight generation.
